provenance.brand-position: measured off the stencil art - smartoptics runs 6.1 to 27.3mm from the body edge and the model name 29.9 to 49.6, both well left of the first port. Decor text anchors on its CENTRE, so these carry the mid-point of each measured span, not its left edge - anchoring the edge value ran the brand off the side of the chassis
provenance.chassis: manual DIMENSIONS (DCP-R) - 440mm (W) x 45mm (H) x 505mm (D), 1 RU. The manual also states power and fan units are in the back panel, so this is a standalone chassis and not a plug-in unit
provenance.column-grid: top and bottom rows agreed to within 0.15mm across all 17 columns, so a single averaged grid is used and the drawing jitter discarded
provenance.markings: photo - IEC 60825 laser hazard triangles in the gap between the two port blocks, one above the top row and one below the bottom
provenance.port-pairing: each LC duplex adapter carries two connection points 6.6mm apart (the Tx and Rx fibers); adapters were recovered by pairing those
provenance.port-positions: stencil ShapeSheet connection points. Visio stores these as FRACTIONS of shape width/height, so they survive without knowing the drawing scale - resolved against the 19-inch rack width the master is drawn at, then expressed from the body edge
provenance.psu-orientation: photo - both modules are fitted the same way round, fan inboard of the inlet, so the C14 sits at the far right on PSU-2 and inboard on PSU-1. They are not mirrored
provenance.psu-part: label - Gospower G1251-0550WNA, P/N CRPS0550-AH, and the fan sticker reads 550W Platinum CRPS. So the module is a standard CRPS 1U part at 73.5 x 40 x 185, not the 84mm-wide estimate taken from the racked photo, and both bays sit flush to the chassis edges
provenance.rear-layout: photo IMG_2181 of racked DCP-R units - PSU with integrated fan and C14 inlet at each end, mirrored; honeycomb vent panel across the centre; management block right of centre. Block positions are approximate to about 3mm - the photo has uncorrected perspective and partial cable occlusion, so it fixes the structure and order but not exact millimetres
provenance.rear-mgmt-block: stencil master dcp-r-rear, which is orthographic - a 2x2 ganged RJ45 shell (ETH 2 / ETH 4 over ETH 1 / ETH 3), ESD warning, Tx and Rx LEDs, an ETH 5 SFP cage and a recessed RESET button
provenance.side-top-bottom: IMG_2188 shows the lid, so these now carry the real finish - a light silver body with the black front panel wrapping about 12.7mm (half an inch) back along every face. Still no vents, screws or lid labels - the photo shows the finish and the panel depth but not those details, so they are left out rather than invented
provenance.silkscreen: port grouping read from the stencil master - XC1 alone, then eight abutting pairs at 13.24mm with about 17.3mm between pairs. Label text corrected from a rack photo - the device prints XC1, not the stencil's XC01, and every port carries a small Tx/Rx box between its name and the adapter, reversed on the bottom row
